symbols.name: ChordObject.state
symbols.comment: The object's state as its references show it.

symbols.name: ChordObject.hydrated
symbols.comment:
Whether its state members have values: once live (a local object stays live until it ends), and while a
restart's old attempt is open (its consumers check their version through `stateFor`).

symbols.name: ChordObject.stateFor
symbols.comment:
The state a same-host consumer of `version` and `fingerprint` sees (rule 5): `live` while a restart's open old
attempt binds that version and its successor is not parked on a failure; otherwise `state`.

symbols.name: ChordObject.oldServes
symbols.comment: Whether a restart's open old attempt binds `version` and `fingerprint`: its consumers of that version may use it.

symbols.name: ChordObject.openOldAttempt
symbols.comment:
A restart's old attempt while it is open (draining, not sealed yet): old work runs on it, and consumers whose
version it binds see it as the live instance; `undefined` otherwise.

symbols.name: ChordObject.firstOutcome
symbols.comment: Resolves at its first outcome (the start barrier waits for it); never rejects.

symbols.name: ChordObject.activating
symbols.comment:
Whether an activation is under way: waiting for its previous instance's teardown, or activating and showing
`loading` (its factory, its natives' opens, a dependency still loading); a parked wait (`failed { waiting }`) is not.

symbols.name: ChordObject.blocksFirstPass
symbols.comment: Whether it holds up the start barrier: it has no first outcome yet.

symbols.name: ChordObject.lastFailure
symbols.comment:
The error of its last failure while none went live since: a failed attempt's, or the cause its parked attempt
showed last (kept when the dependency falls back to `loading`, so a getter's deadline names it).

symbols.name: ChordObject.activationSpan
symbols.comment: The span of the activation under way, when one runs and is recorded (getters waiting for it link to it).

symbols.name: ChordObject.activationId
symbols.comment: Its instance id while an attempt activates; `undefined` otherwise (a hold's chain names only activations).

symbols.name: ChordObject.activationChain
symbols.comment:
The chain a hold this object's activation makes over a link carries (Q5): its own chain and its instance id, the
last 32; `undefined` when it is not activating.

symbols.name: ChordObject.holders
symbols.comment: Its holders, for a presence list made after they took it.

symbols.name: ChordObject.variant
symbols.comment:
The variant a live remote object's factory chose (a restart's open old attempt's meanwhile); `undefined` for a
local object and before it is live.

symbols.name: ChordObject.stateMembers
symbols.comment: The live object's state members, as Chord follows them.

symbols.name: ChordObject.attempt
symbols.comment:
Starts an attempt when waiting or failed and returns it; a trigger while an attempt runs (or once live) is ignored.
After a failure the holders are told: their references are loading again.

symbols.name: ChordObject.retry
symbols.comment:
`ref.retry()` and a `retry` message, as a step of `walk` (handled once per walk: a diamond reaches it twice): an
attempt now when failed (a broken one too) or waiting, its backoff window skipped; passed on to the failed
dependencies while parked `failed { waiting }`; ignored otherwise (an attempt runs, or it is live).

symbols.name: ChordObject.retryOn
symbols.comment:
Follows `sources` as its wake signals instead of the last attempt's (`self.retryOn`, right after a factory
returned): a new value retries it while failed, as `ref.retry()` does; one while it activates retries it at once
if that attempt fails; one while live does nothing.

symbols.name: ChordObject.call
symbols.signature:
async call(
		method: string,
		args: unknown,
		context: Context,
		caller: Caller,
		version: number,
		parent?: TelemetryContext,
	): Promise<unknown>
symbols.comment:
Calls a method of the live object for `caller`, bound at `version` (an older one maps its arguments and result,
Q10), its `chord.method` span under `parent` (the caller's span on this host, a call's carrier over a link). While
an attempt activates (a reload's restart, a retry), new work waits for its outcome (the gate); old work runs on a
restart's open old attempt.

symbols.name: ChordObject.binds
symbols.comment: Whether a consumer of `contract`'s version and fingerprint binds to this object's provider now (R6, Q10).

symbols.name: ChordObject.checkedParams
symbols.comment: Its params as checked, with their identity key.

symbols.name: ChordObject.followed
symbols.comment:
What a reference of `version` follows for state member `member` now (decision "References are the only
indirection"): the shown instance's member (its mapping at an older version) while that instance is live, while a
restart keeps it open, and after a live failure until its admitted commits published; else nothing:
`failed` with the cause's error, or `loading`, with that member to take a last value from.

symbols.name: ChordObject.attachable
symbols.comment:
The instance its references follow now (they attach to it; they take last values only from an instance they
attached to); `undefined` once it stopped changing.

symbols.name: ChordObject.instance
symbols.comment:
The live instance, which references pin their keys on (a new one: they pin again), or a restart's open old
attempt; `undefined` otherwise.

symbols.name: ChordObject.liveMember
symbols.comment: The live instance's state member `member` as a consumer of `version` follows it (a hold over a link).

symbols.name: ChordObject.keyedMapping
symbols.signature: keyedMapping(member: string, version: number): ((current: JsonValue) => JsonValue) | undefined
symbols.comment: How a consumer of `version` reads keyed member `member`'s documents: mapped back when older (`undefined`: as they are).

symbols.name: ChordObject.#openerGate
symbols.comment:
The gate, with an activation's opener waiting here recorded as an edge of its object (a wait of old work on that
object then sees it), the waits of old work checked again when one starts.

symbols.name: ChordObject.waitEdges
symbols.comment:
What its activation waits for now (reload cycles, rule 6): the objects its parked attempt's dependencies are bound
to, and those whose gate its opener waits at.

symbols.name: ChordObject.#gate
symbols.comment:
Waits while an attempt activates until the object is live, failed or ended (`#live` then calls or throws);
rejects with the cause once the attempt parks on a failed dependency (`failed { waiting }`), and with
`unavailable/park_timeout` after `readyTimeout`, as a call parked on a reference. A hold over a link stays bound
while a restart's old attempt is open, so its consumer sees `live` and sends calls that arrive here: new work
waits for the new attempt, never `not_ready`.

symbols.name: ChordObject.keyedMember
symbols.comment: The keyed member `member` of the live object: its ultimate slot (slice 6a §12).

symbols.name: ChordObject.pinKey
symbols.signature: pinKey(member: string, key: string, version: number, context: Context): Promise<PinnedKey>
symbols.comment: Pins `key` of keyed member `member` on the live instance, as a consumer of `version` reads it (`Attempt.pinKey`).

symbols.name: ChordObject.hold
symbols.comment:
Counts `holder` as a reference to this object (the holder reads `state` itself), listed in its type's presence; a
lingering object stays.

symbols.name: ChordObject.unhold
symbols.comment: `holder` was released: the object may end (`#idle`).

symbols.name: ChordObject.jobRecords
symbols.comment:
The records of job `definition`'s runs, made by its first declaration. A later declaration (a new attempt's, after a
reload) at another version takes the records over (each run keeps its version, slice 7b §8); one at the same
version with another fingerprint is refused (`checkJob`).

symbols.name: ChordObject.checkJob
symbols.comment: Refuses a declaration of a job its records cannot take (`JobRecords.check`); a reload's staging checks it too.

symbols.name: ChordObject.claimTable
symbols.comment:
Claims table `table` (its SQL name) in the host's store for this object, until its end (slice 6b claims); held by
another owner: `invalid/args`, which fails the declaring factory.

symbols.name: ChordObject.liveQueries
symbols.comment: Its live queries by table (`self.query`), across its attempts: what its commits writing a table re-run.

symbols.name: ChordObject.claimDocuments
symbols.comment: Claims this object's documents in `namespace` of the host's store, as `claimTable`.

symbols.name: ChordObject.failLive
symbols.comment:
A runtime failure of the live attempt `attempt`: `broken` (a `migrate` failing on access, a stored version newer
than the code, a refused commit) or `transient` (a followed runtime failed, R4): the attempt is sealed and the
object `failed` with `cause`; calls reject with it, holders are told, its references keep their last values once the
admitted commits adopted (`followed`), the natives close in the background (then its references are released),
`onError` gets `object_failed` once. Documents and job runs stay. Recovery: a broken failure by `ref.retry()`, a
transient one after its identity's backoff too (a new attempt, whose members its references follow once live). A
failure of a sealed attempt is ignored, so several at once fail it once.

symbols.name: ChordObject.#heldUntil
symbols.comment: A held state change must be stored by `deadline`: the timer is set for the earliest one.

symbols.name: ChordObject.#flushHeld
symbols.comment: The timer fired: every held change past its deadline is stored, and the timer set for the next one.

symbols.name: ChordObject.countRuns
symbols.comment:
Adds `delta` to its running and finishing job runs (and `host.activity.jobs`). A new run keeps a lingering object;
the last one settling on an object without references ends it as its last release would (`#idle`).

symbols.name: ChordObject.assertNoCycle
symbols.comment:
Throws `invalid/cycle` when waiting for `dependency` closes a chain of waits back to this object (Q5). Every other
object on the chain fails broken with the same error, so no part of a cycle waits for a retry. Counts the objects
it visits (`chord.cycle.visits`). Otherwise, a dependency whose activation is in this object's chain closes a
cycle through other hosts (they fail through their dependency on this one).

symbols.name: ChordObject.waitsFor
symbols.comment: Its parked attempt waits for `dependencies` (none once it leaves parking): the waits a cycle check follows.

symbols.name: ChordObject.dependencyMoved
symbols.comment:
A dependency of its current attempt changed (its state, or its first outcome): a parked attempt checks again; an
attempt past its dependency check ignores it (R18 after live), and so does any other state.

symbols.name: ChordObject.parked
symbols.signature: parked(attempt: Attempt, shown: RefState, firstPass: boolean): void
symbols.comment:
Its attempt `attempt` is parked showing `shown` (`loading` or `failed { waiting }`): holders are told when that
changed (a cause compared by value). `firstPass`: no blocker here is still without its first outcome, so this
object has its first outcome now.

symbols.name: ChordObject.unparked
symbols.comment: Its attempt `attempt` left parking for its own steps: it shows `loading` until its outcome.

symbols.name: ChordObject.#dropKept
symbols.comment: The contributions a restart kept for its successor leave the tables (F-c): it will not take them over now.

symbols.name: ChordObject.end
symbols.comment:
Ends the object (once): sealed now, its holders and running calls told `error` (`released` by default), torn down
in the background with reason `end`, close failures reported.

symbols.name: ChordObject.stop
symbols.comment:
Ends the object for `host.close`: sealed now; returns its teardown (reason `close`), which the host runs once every
object is sealed, so no reference it releases starts an ending in the background.

symbols.name: ChordObject.remove
symbols.comment:
Ends the object because a reload removed its type (slice 7b §4): as `end` (natives close with reason `end`,
running calls' callers rejected `released`, handlers drained), but its holders' requests are not ended: they wait
unbound with `cause` (`not_served`), references with their last values, until the next object of its identity
binds them (`Removal`).

symbols.name: ChordObject.reloadFate
symbols.comment: What a reload does to this object, whose type is still served: a live object restarts, any other is retried.

symbols.name: ChordObject.reload
symbols.signature: reload(served: Served, fate: ReloadFate, requests: readonly Request[]): Attempt
symbols.comment:
Takes `fate` with its new served type (after the reload's commit) and, for a restart, its new factory's requests as
staging recorded them; returns the new attempt, whose first dependency check the reload's report waits for (a
retry's).

symbols.name: ChordObject.#restart
symbols.comment:
A restart (decision "Reload restarts every affected object; old work finishes on old code"): its routines stop,
new calls wait at the gate, old work runs on the old attempt, and consumers whose version it binds see it live; its
contributions stay (until its seal with natives, F-b; until its successor is live without, F-c). It is sealed once
its successor's recorded requests are ready and its calls, routed old work included, drained, bounded by the
reload drain bound; then its natives close with reason `reload` and the successor, a new instance (D4), runs its
factory. Readiness and successor start once every fate of the reload started (`startSuccessor`).

symbols.name: ChordObject.#endOld
symbols.signature: async #endOld(old: Attempt, readiness: Readiness, due: number): Promise<CloseFailed[]>
symbols.comment:
Ends a restart's old attempt: once its successor's requests are ready and its calls drained (routed old work joins
while the drain runs), by `due`; sealed (in-memory job runs end `aborted { reload }`), its references take their
last values once its admitted commits published (a store write is not a running call's promise), its natives
close with reason `reload`.

symbols.name: ChordObject.startSuccessor
symbols.comment: Starts a restart's readiness and its successor, once every fate of the reload started (its served types are new).

symbols.name: ChordObject.#startRestarted
symbols.signature:
#startRestarted(
		attempt: Attempt,
		old: Attempt,
		readiness: Readiness,
		ended: Promise<unknown>,
		ending: Promise<void> | undefined,
	): void
symbols.comment:
Binds the readiness, whose failures the successor shows until the old attempt ended (`#readinessShown`). The
successor runs after `ending`; once the old attempt ended (`ended`) and the successor's own requests bound, the old
attempt's references and the readiness bindings are released (F-a: a dependency held only by them never ends; a
successor a later reload replaces never releases them early).

symbols.name: ChordObject.readinessCause
symbols.comment: What a restart's readiness finds now: a failed request the successor waits for, if any (the report's).

symbols.name: ChordObject.#readinessShown
symbols.comment:
A restart's readiness found `cause` (a failed request), or none any more: while the old attempt has not ended, the
successor `attempt` shows it (new calls get the cause, consumers see the failure; old work still runs on the old
attempt), and shows `loading` again once the request recovered. Its kept contributions stay: only the successor's
own failure or park drops them (F-c).

symbols.name: ChordObject.#caller
symbols.comment: Whom its own requests act as: the host for a local object, its principal for a remote one.

symbols.name: ChordObject.#retryReloaded
symbols.comment:
A reload retries an object that is not live (slice 7b §9, decision 1): a parked attempt is replaced in one
handover (it opened nothing: the new attempt's requests bind before the old ones are released, M§3.9); an attempt
in its own steps is sealed, its natives close with reason `reload`, and the new one activates after that teardown;
a failed or waiting one gets an attempt now, its backoff skipped.

symbols.name: ChordObject.#replace
symbols.comment: A new attempt replacing the current one, holders told; its caller starts it (`#run`) after what it waits for.

symbols.name: ChordObject.#newAttempt
symbols.comment: Its next attempt, its activation span linked to the trigger of the last (or its first trigger).

symbols.name: ChordObject.#reloaded
symbols.comment: The `released` error of an attempt a reload replaced.

symbols.name: ChordObject.ended
symbols.comment: The `released` error of this object.

symbols.name: ChordObject.#run
symbols.signature: async #run(attempt: Attempt, ending: Promise<void> | undefined): Promise<void>
symbols.comment: Runs `attempt`'s activation once `ending` (its predecessors' teardowns, if any) finished; takes its outcome.

symbols.name: ChordObject.#takeJobs
symbols.comment:
After `attempt` went live: the jobs it does not declare block their runs (slice 7b §8); after a reload, the blocked
runs of the jobs it declares are retried.

symbols.name: ChordObject.#unbindUnfit
symbols.comment:
Its holders whose version `attempt`'s provider (going live) does not bind (a reload dropped it, slice 7b §6), or
of which it refuses a member (`contract_mismatch`), leave it: they wait unbound `version` (`failed { waiting }`),
references with their last values, until a publication serves their version again. The object and its other
holders stay.

symbols.name: ChordObject.#heldAt
symbols.comment: Whether a holder of `version` holds it.

symbols.name: ChordObject.#unfit
symbols.comment:
Why `holder` cannot bind to `attempt` (live): its version is not one the provider binds, or the provider refuses a
member of it (`contract_mismatch`); `undefined` when it binds.

symbols.name: ChordObject.#unbound
symbols.comment: `holder` (no longer held) waits unbound with `error` (`failed { waiting }`) until a publication fits it.

symbols.name: ChordObject.#failed
symbols.comment:
Records a failed attempt: reported, torn down in the background (reason `end`), its references released once its
natives closed, its holders told. Transient: a backoff window, whose end is the failure's `retryAt`; broken: no
automatic retry.

symbols.name: ChordObject.#wake
symbols.comment:
A wake signal's new value (inside its batch): retries a failed object (after the batch: a factory may not run in
one), remembered while it activates, ignored while live and when its own contributions' leaving made it.

symbols.name: ChordObject.#withdraw
symbols.comment:
The live attempt `attempt` leaves the registries' tables (it fails or ends), inside a batch; a composition this
leaving makes wakes no wake signal of this object.

symbols.name: ChordObject.#stopFollowing
symbols.comment:
`attempt`, the instance shown, stopped changing (a live failure's admitted commits published, a restart's old
attempt sealed): its references take their last values from it, holds leave it, and the object lets it go (a
reference made later never attached to it: it takes nothing from it).

symbols.name: ChordObject.#notify
symbols.comment: Tells every holder that the state changed: references first follow what it shows now (`followed`).

symbols.name: ChordObject.#wakeGate
symbols.comment: Calls waiting at the gate check the state again.

symbols.name: ChordObject.#seal
symbols.comment:
Marks the object ended: forgotten by the host, waits rejected, references to it ended with `error` (and gone from
its type's presence), its job runs ended (signals fired, waiters rejected), its transactions refused, its attempt
sealed. Returns what is left to tear down; it releases nothing itself.

symbols.name: ChordObject.#dropUnheld
symbols.comment:
The last holder of `version` left: the shown instance's shared mapping for it goes (Opus F2), so a long-lived
object keeps no mapped value nobody reads.

symbols.name: ChordObject.#idle
symbols.comment:
A remote object or a local one with params ends once it has no references and no running or finishing job runs:
a live one once its type's `linger` passed without a new reference, any other at once.

symbols.name: ChordObject.#stopLingering
symbols.comment: Its linger timer stops (a new holder, its expiry, its end): no longer counted as lingering.

symbols.name: ChordObject.#tearDown
symbols.comment:
Once the previous teardowns finished (a failed attempt's closes may read the documents): drains and closes a
sealed attempt, then releases its references (after the closes, which may use them), then waits for an admitted
commit step to adopt and drops the documents and job runs. Resolves with the closes that threw.

symbols.name: ChordObject.#reported
symbols.comment: Reports the close failures of a teardown nobody waits for.

symbols.name: ChordObject.#live
symbols.comment:
The live attempt, or a restart's open old attempt (its consumers saw it live); `not_ready` before the object went
live and while it activates again, the cause while failed, `released` once it ended.

symbols.name: ChordObject.#settleFirstOutcome
symbols.comment: The settlement of its first outcome (once): dependents parked on it check their first pass again.

symbols.name: ChordObject.pathTo
symbols.signature: pathTo(target: ChordObject, visited: Set<Target>): ChordObject[] | undefined
symbols.comment: The chain of waits from this activation to `target` (see `Target`), through its parked attempt's dependencies.

symbols.name: sameState
symbols.signature: function sameState(a: RefState, b: RefState): boolean
symbols.comment: Whether two states of a reference say the same: the same object, or failures with the same cause (by value).

packages/chord/src/host/object.ts.comment:
Objects (§6): one per identity, from its first attempt to its end. Its state across attempts (its documents, line

and job runs), the instance its references follow (`followed`: decision "References are the only indirection"), its

holders, retries after failures (backoff, `ref.retry()`, passed

on while parked), what it shows while its attempt is parked on dependencies (dependency model §3), its first outcome

(the start barrier, decision (a)), a live object's failure (slice 6a §1.4), the waits and cycle checks of activations

(Q5, its instance id and the activation chain it was created for), lingering after its last reference (§3, D8), the

job runs that keep it alive (§15), its contributions to registries while live and its wake signals (`retryOn`, slice

8), its ending, revocation included (§4, R11), and what a reload does to it (decision "Reload restarts every affected

object; old work finishes on old code"): a restart, whose old attempt serves old work until it drained and its

successor's requests are ready, a retry on the new code, or its end by its type's removal, after which its

references wait with their last values and follow the next object of the identity.

symbols.name: CallNode
symbols.comment: One link of a call chain: the attempt a method call runs on, and the chain of the call that made it (`up`).

symbols.name: on
symbols.comment: The attempt the call runs on: old work while that attempt drains for a restart.

symbols.name: OldWorkSource
symbols.signature: export type OldWorkSource = { readonly draining: boolean };
symbols.comment: What a call chain's node runs on: an attempt, or another host's old work.

symbols.name: CALL_CHAIN
symbols.comment: The key under which a context carries its call chain (a method ctx is its own node: no allocation per call).

symbols.name: OPENING
symbols.comment:
The key under which an attempt's activation context carries its object: a call its opener makes is known as that
object's (its gate waits are the object's wait edges for reload cycles).

symbols.name: OldWork
symbols.comment: The host's old work: whether a context runs under it, counted so that the check is free outside reloads.

symbols.name: OldWork.#count
symbols.comment: The open old attempts of restarts and the old calls from other hosts running here now.

symbols.name: OldWork.open
symbols.comment: An old attempt began draining, or an old call from another host began running here.

symbols.name: OldWork.close
symbols.comment: The counterpart of `open`.

symbols.name: OldWork.of
symbols.comment: Whether `context` runs under old work (walked only while this host has any).

symbols.name: REMOTE_OLD_WORK
symbols.comment: The chain node of a call that arrived as old work from another host: always old, with nothing above it.

symbols.name: asRemoteOldWork
symbols.comment: `context` marked as old work that arrived from another host (`call.old` on a trusted link).

symbols.name: chainAttempts
symbols.comment: The attempts of `context`'s call chain, for the reload cycle check (another host's old work has none here).

packages/chord/src/host/old-work.ts.comment:
Old work during a reload (decision "Reload restarts every affected object; old work finishes on old code"): the calls

running on a restart's open old attempt and every call they cause. A call is old work when its call chain (the method

ctxs it runs under, found through its context) holds an attempt that a restart drains, or when it arrived as old work

from another host (`call.old` on a trusted link). The host counts its open old attempts and the old calls it runs

for other hosts, so outside reloads no chain is walked.

symbols.name: ParkedCall
symbols.comment: One queued call: what to send, how its caller is settled, its deadline (`Date.now()` time) and what ends its wait.

symbols.name: ParkedCalls
symbols.comment:
The queue of one reference's parked calls. A call leaves it when it is sent, at its deadline (`unavailable/
park_timeout`), when its caller cancels, or rejected with the queue (the reference failed or was released).

symbols.name: ParkedCalls.#calls
symbols.comment: In the order the calls were made (a `Set` keeps insertion order and deletes in constant time).

symbols.name: ParkedCalls.waiting
symbols.comment: Whether calls are queued: a new call waits behind them, also while they are being sent.

symbols.name: ParkedCalls.park
symbols.signature: park(method: string, args: unknown, context: Context): Promise<unknown>
symbols.comment: Queues a call; settles as the call it becomes once sent, or with why it left the queue.

symbols.name: ParkedCalls.flush
symbols.signature: flush(send: (method: string, args: unknown, context: Context) => Promise<unknown>, live: () => boolean): void
symbols.comment:
Sends the queued calls in order through `send`, each only while `live()` still holds: sending one runs code
(a handler's synchronous part) that may release or drop the reference, and the rest then stays queued or is
rejected by that; or that makes a new call, which is queued behind the rest and sent in this loop. A call whose
deadline passed while earlier ones ran (their timers could not fire) is rejected instead of sent.
inputs: send: (method: string, args: unknown, context: Context) => Promise<unknown>

symbols.name: ParkedCalls.reject
symbols.comment: Rejects every queued call with `error`.

symbols.name: ParkedCalls.#expire
symbols.comment: `call`'s deadline passed: `unavailable/park_timeout`.

symbols.name: ParkedCalls.#take
symbols.comment: Takes `call` out of the queue: its deadline and cancellation stop.

packages/chord/src/host/parked.ts.comment:
Parked calls (§3, §7): calls made on a loading reference, queued in the order they were made until it goes live,

each with its own deadline from the moment it was called (the reference's `readyTimeout`, never renewed).

symbols.name: Presence
symbols.comment:
One reference to an object of `C`: the object's params, the principal it acts as (for a remote type), and its
incarnation: the host that made it as its caller sees it (a hold's caller over a link; two tabs are two
incarnations), the word `ctx.incarnation` uses.

symbols.name: References
symbols.comment:
The references of one type, made by the host for its first `host.references(Type)` and kept from then on: one entry
per reference, added when it binds and removed when it ends, in the batch where that happens (derives over it
recompute there). While watched, a batch's changes are folded into the published list once, with one splice op per
removal and one for the additions; otherwise the list is built on its next read.

symbols.name: References.#list
symbols.comment: The list as last published or read; `undefined` once it changed while nobody watched it.

symbols.name: References.#added
symbols.comment: Entries added since `#list`, in order (only while it is defined).

symbols.name: References.#removed
symbols.comment: Entries of `#list` removed since.

symbols.name: References.#ops
symbols.comment: The ops folding `#list` forward, for the current batch's frame.

symbols.name: References.add
symbols.signature: add(object: ChordObject, holder: Holder, context: Context): void
symbols.comment: `holder` references `object`, added in the batch running now or the next one.

symbols.name: References.remove
symbols.comment: `holders` of `object` ended, removed in one batch.

symbols.name: References.record
symbols.comment: Records `holder` without a batch (the list being made) and returns its entry.

symbols.name: References.#follows
symbols.comment:
Whether a change is folded into the published list: while watched (a watch read the list first). Otherwise the
list is dropped and built on its next read.

symbols.name: References.#fold
symbols.comment:
Folds the changes since `#list` into a new list, once: a removal is one splice op at its index, the additions one
splice op at the end. Builds the list from the entries when there is none.

packages/chord/src/host/presence.ts.comment:
Presence (§19): `host.references(Type)`, a JSON watchable of the references to objects of one type on this host, one

entry per reference with the object's params, the reference's principal (remote types) and its incarnation.

symbols.name: Readiness
symbols.comment:
One restart's readiness: ready once each recorded type request is live (an open old instance that binds its version
counts) or failed for a reason other than another host's version skew (which heals by itself), or at its bound.
Registry requests are served by facets in the commit and kept by the old attempt's contributions until its seal: it
does not wait for them. Its failure follows the requests: `shows` gets each change of it.

symbols.name: Readiness.#abort
symbols.comment: Ends the waits on its bindings at its release.

symbols.name: Readiness.#refused
symbols.comment: A request refused for good at the start (an authority, a host address): it heals with no change of a binding.

symbols.name: Readiness.#failed
symbols.signature: #failed: { readonly from: FailureCause; readonly waiting: FailureCause } | undefined;
symbols.comment: The failed request's cause `shows` got last (`from`), as the successor waits for it (`waiting`).
symbols.output: { readonly from: FailureCause; readonly waiting: FailureCause } | undefined

symbols.name: Readiness.constructor
symbols.signature:
constructor(
		host: AnyHost,
		caller: Caller,
		requests: readonly Request[],
		shows: (cause: FailureCause | undefined) => void,
		context: Context,
	)

symbols.name: Readiness.cause
symbols.comment: What the successor waits for now: a request refused for good, or `waiting` for the first failed one.

symbols.name: Readiness.start
symbols.comment:
Binds the recorded type requests as the object's own would be (once every fate of the reload started), kept out
of presence lists (they are no consumers of their own), and follows them: `shows` gets each change of `cause`.

symbols.name: Readiness.ready
symbols.comment: Resolves once every request is ready, or at `due` (`Date.now()` time), whichever is first.

symbols.name: Readiness.release
symbols.comment: The successor's own requests bound: its bindings are let go (a dependency held only by them never ends).

symbols.name: Readiness.#changed
symbols.comment: A binding changed: `shows` gets the failure if it is another one now.

symbols.name: Readiness.#firstFailed
symbols.signature: #firstFailed(): { readonly label: string; readonly cause: FailureCause } | undefined
symbols.comment: The first request failed for a reason other than another host's version skew, with its cause.
symbols.output: { readonly label: string; readonly cause: FailureCause } | undefined

symbols.name: isReady
symbols.comment: Whether a request is ready: live, ended, or failed for a reason other than a version skew.

symbols.name: versionSkew
symbols.comment:
Whether `binding` failed for another host's version refusal (its own, or a dependency's along the chain: `waiting`
causes keep the reason): that heals when the other host's reload lands, so the old attempt stays open meanwhile,
bounded as always. A refusal on this host heals by no other reload: it is no skew.

packages/chord/src/host/readiness.ts.comment:
A restart's readiness (decision "Reload restarts every affected object; old work finishes on old code", rule 3):

the requests its new factory made in staging, bound once every fate of the reload started (every served type is the

new one then), and held until the successor's own requests bound. The old attempt is sealed only once they are

ready, so old work that reaches the object meanwhile still finds its old attempt open.

symbols.name: RefState
symbols.comment:
Where a reference stands. `loading`: its object activates, retries or is parked on dependencies still under way, it
waits for its host's publication or a parent link, or its link is down (the reference's coarser view of its object's
waiting and activating); `failed`: its object failed and no attempt runs (`transient`: `retryAt` is when its backoff
retries it; `broken`: no automatic retry), or nothing fits it or its object is parked on a failed dependency
(`waiting`: an event wakes it, `retryAt` undefined); `live`: bound; `ended`: for good, with the error that says why
(`released` without a reason: released by its holder; `released/ended`: its object ended; `released/closed`: its
host closed; `forbidden/revoked`).

symbols.name: Failed
symbols.signature: export type Failed = Extract<RefState, { readonly kind: "failed" }>;
symbols.comment: A failed reference's state.

symbols.name: Ended
symbols.signature: export type Ended = Extract<RefState, { readonly kind: "ended" }>;
symbols.comment: An ended reference's state.

symbols.name: LOADING
symbols.comment: The states without fields, one object each: a change of state is a new object (a native watch compares by identity).

symbols.name: ReferenceState
symbols.comment:
`ref.state`, a native source: its value is the reference's state, read through `read`; each watch gets every new
state, in its own context (not one call per batch, as a followed source's), and ends `ended` when the reference is
released (the end is the notification). Derives reading it are marked in a batch of its own when it changes.

symbols.name: ReferenceState.#watches
symbols.comment: The watches with the contexts they were taken in, which their frames carry.

symbols.name: ReferenceState.#last
symbols.comment: The state the watches have: a change is announced only when the state is another object.

symbols.name: ReferenceState.watch
symbols.comment: Every state in order: a watch sees each step it went through.

symbols.name: ReferenceState.moved
symbols.comment: The reference's state may have changed: every watch gets it when it is another state, derives are marked.

symbols.name: ReferenceState.released
symbols.comment: The reference ended (`ended`, the reference's state): every watch ends `ended`, derives are marked a last time.

symbols.name: ReferenceState.#mark
symbols.comment:
Marks the derives reading it, in the batch running now or one of its own (apart from `moved`: a closure there
would allocate on every state change). A reference has no context of its own: the background context.

packages/chord/src/host/ref-state.ts.comment:
The state of a reference (§7): loading, live, failed or ended; and `ref.state`, the native watchable that follows

it.

symbols.name: KeyHolder
symbols.comment: What a reference's keys need of it.

symbols.name: KeyHolder.version
symbols.comment: Its contract version: keys are mapped to it.

symbols.name: KeyHolder.target
symbols.comment: The object it is bound to; `undefined` while unbound.

symbols.name: KeyHolder.none
symbols.comment: What a read throws while a key never had a value.

symbols.name: KeyEntry
symbols.comment: One key of one keyed member held by the reference: its source, its users, and the instance pin it follows.

symbols.name: instance
symbols.comment: The live instance its pin is (or is being) taken on; `undefined` while it points at nothing.

symbols.name: pin
symbols.comment: The pin it follows.

symbols.name: loading
symbols.comment: The pin in flight, settled once the source follows it.

symbols.name: ReferenceKeys
symbols.comment: A reference's held keys; every instance pin below them released exactly once.

symbols.name: ReferenceKeys.hold
symbols.signature: async hold(member: string, key: string, context: Context): Promise<PinnedKey>
symbols.comment:
Holds `key` of keyed member `member`: its source once pinned and loaded on the live instance; `context` ends only
this caller's wait. `release` (once) lets it go with its last holder.

symbols.name: ReferenceKeys.follow
ReferenceKeys.fail
symbols.comment: Its reference left its object (`error`: why it waits), inside a batch: keys keep their last values, pins go.

symbols.name: ReferenceKeys.end
symbols.comment: Its reference ended, inside a batch: every key ends with `error` and releases its pin.

symbols.name: ReferenceKeys.#entry
symbols.comment: The entry of `member` and `key`, made by the first holder.

symbols.name: ReferenceKeys.#pin
symbols.comment:
Pins `entry`'s key on the target's live instance (once per instance): the source keeps its last value meanwhile,
follows the pin when it lands (one frame) and releases the previous one; a failed load shows as its failure.

symbols.name: ReferenceKeys.#release
symbols.comment: One holder of `entry` left; the last drops it and its pin.

symbols.name: ReferenceKeys.#unpin
symbols.comment: Releases the pin `entry` follows or awaits: it points at nothing until pinned again.

packages/chord/src/host/reference-keys.t.comment:
The keys a reference holds (slice 6a §12; decision "References are the only indirection" (4)): its key watches and

its factory's pins (`at(key)`) of its object's keyed members, one source per member and key shared by them, pinned on

the object's live instance (loaded, mapped to the reference's version). While the object still follows the instance a

key is pinned on (a restart's open old attempt, a live failure's admitted commits) the key follows it on,

as members do. When the reference moves to a new instance or a new object it pins the key there again, keeping the

last value until that pin loads, then one frame; while it points at nothing the key keeps its last value (one

`failed` call when its target failed, none while it loads).

symbols.name: SourceState
symbols.comment:
Where a reference's source stands: never had a value (`unbound`: reads throw what its reference has instead),
following an instance's member, holding its last value while pointing at nothing (`failure` while its target is
failed: new watches start with it; `told`: its watches got a failure since that value, so the next is whole), failed
(a member its target's live variant lacks, or its compute threw when it was held: reads throw, `last` is the last
good value) or ended with its reference (nothing kept).

symbols.name: SourceOwner
symbols.comment: A reference owning its sources: what a read of one that never had a value throws.

symbols.name: NO_FAILURE
symbols.comment: No failure told: a held value's `failure` while its target loads.

symbols.name: ReferenceSource
symbols.signature: export class ReferenceSource extends Source implements Dependent {
symbols.comment:
One member (or key) of one reference. Bound, it is a dependent of the instance's member (its own dependents are
marked with it); its watches and subscribers subscribe to that member itself, so the member's frames reach them as
they are, and a derive member stays lazy while nothing follows it; holding or moving moves them.

symbols.name: ReferenceSource.#passed
symbols.comment:
Its watches and subscribers, each subscribed to the bound member while bound; held, they get nothing. Made by the
first.

symbols.name: ReferenceSource.#framed
symbols.comment: What its watches had at a re-bind (`undefined` for no value: they had a failure), until the re-bind's frame.

symbols.name: ReferenceSource.#owner
symbols.comment: Its reference: what a read throws while it never had a value (its failure, `not_ready`, or `released`).

symbols.name: ReferenceSource.unbound
symbols.comment: Whether it never had a value (a watch waits for its reference's values first).

symbols.name: ReferenceSource.start
symbols.comment: What a new watch starts at: the bound member's start, the held value (after its failure), or the failure.

symbols.name: ReferenceSource.openWatch
symbols.comment:
A watch subscribed to the bound member itself (as `Source.openWatch` starts one: on a failed member at its last
good value, the failure first).

symbols.name: ReferenceSource.inUse
symbols.comment: Whether anything follows it: a watch, a subscriber or a derive (moving or ending it then needs a batch).

symbols.name: ReferenceSource.watched
symbols.comment: Whether a watch or a subscriber follows it (through the bound member).

symbols.name: ReferenceSource.subscribe
symbols.comment: Feeds `subscriber` the bound member's frames (it subscribes there) and the moves' frames.

symbols.name: ReferenceSource.unsubscribe
symbols.comment: As `Source.unsubscribe`.

symbols.name: ReferenceSource.invalidate
symbols.comment: The bound member changed: its dependents are marked (its frames reach the subscribers directly).

symbols.name: ReferenceSource.sourceRetired
symbols.comment: The bound member's document was retired: its dependents carry the flag on.

symbols.name: ReferenceSource.bind
symbols.comment:
Follows `source`, an instance's member, inside a batch: watches get one frame from the last value (a full one
after a failure); derives downstream are marked and recompute, a failed one included (self-healing).

symbols.name: ReferenceSource.hold
symbols.comment: Its target loads (a restart, a retry, a new object not live yet): it keeps its last value, and tells nothing.

symbols.name: ReferenceSource.fail
symbols.comment:
Its target failed (`error`: its cause's, a refused version's, a removed type's), inside a batch: it keeps its last
value, its watches and subscribers get one failure call (once per failure) and stay open.

symbols.name: ReferenceSource.vanish
symbols.comment:
Its target's live variant lacks the member, inside a batch: reads throw `error`; watches and subscribers get one
failure call and stay open (a later instance may bring the member back, as `[["r", value]]`).

symbols.name: ReferenceSource.end
symbols.comment:
Its reference ended, inside a batch: reads throw `error`, watches end `ended`, and derives over it are marked
(their next read throws it, no cached value stays).

symbols.name: ReferenceSource.deliver
symbols.comment: Delivers a move's frame: the diff from the watches' value to the new member's.

symbols.name: ReferenceSource.#keep
symbols.comment:
Stops following the bound member and keeps its value (`failure`: the failure it is held with); a member whose value
throws becomes failed. Whether it holds a value.

symbols.name: ReferenceSource.#call
symbols.comment: A call of its own (a move's frame, a failure) to its watches and subscribers.

symbols.name: ReferenceSource.#shown
symbols.comment:
The value its watches have before a move; `undefined` when they had a failure since it (their next value is whole,
`[["r", value]]`, even when unchanged).

symbols.name: ReferenceSource.#lastGood
symbols.comment: Its last good value, which watches opened while it is failed start at; `undefined` when it never had one.

symbols.name: ReferenceSource.#hook
symbols.comment: Starts reading `source`: its changes mark this source's dependents, its frames reach the subscribers.

symbols.name: ReferenceSource.#leave
symbols.comment: Stops following the bound source, when bound: no more marks or frames from it.

packages/chord/src/host/reference-source.comment:
A reference's member as consumers follow it (decision "References are the only indirection", §7): a consumer's

watches and derives over `ref.member` (or a key of a keyed member) attach here, and this passes them straight through

to the object instance's own document or derive (its watches and subscribers subscribe there: no extra hop on

commits, the commit's value and ops by reference). When the reference's target moves to a new instance (or a new

object of its identity), it moves them and sends one frame, a diff from the last value; while it points at nothing it

keeps the last value (a pointer, no copy), with one `failed` call when its target failed (none while it loads).

symbols.name: Reference
symbols.comment:
A reference: a local contract's members, or for a remote contract the members of the variant its object chose,
narrowed by `variant`; and its state, `retry()` and `release()`. Every use after release throws.
symbols.output:
ShapeOf<C>["kind"] extends "local"
	? Implementation<C> & Lifecycle
	: InVariants<C, never>

symbols.name: Held
symbols.comment: What `host.hold` returns: a reference whose `variant` is `undefined` until its first binding.
symbols.output:
ShapeOf<C>["kind"] extends "local"
	? Implementation<C> & Lifecycle
	: InVariants<C, undefined>

symbols.name: RefIn
symbols.signature: export type RefIn<C extends Contract, V extends string> = Extract<Reference<C>, { readonly variant: V }>;
symbols.comment: A remote reference narrowed to some of its variants.

symbols.name: InVariants
symbols.comment: One member of a remote reference's union per variant; `Unbound` is what `variant` may also be.

symbols.name: Lifecycle
symbols.comment: What every reference has besides its members.

symbols.name: state
symbols.comment: The reference's state: loading, live, failed or released; watches get every change.

symbols.name: retry
symbols.comment:
Asks a failed object for an attempt now (the backoff skipped, a broken one renewed); an object parked on failed
dependencies passes it on to them, once; otherwise nothing.

symbols.name: Target
symbols.comment:
What a binding is bound to: an object on this host (`ChordObject`), or an object held over a path, the parent link
or a route address (`RemoteObject`). It tells its holders of each change of `state`.

symbols.name: Target.kind
symbols.comment: Where it is: an object on this host, or one held over a link (another host decides what it serves).

symbols.name: Target.label
symbols.comment: The object in errors: its type, and its params key when it has params.

symbols.name: Target.state
symbols.comment: Its state as its references show it.

symbols.name: Target.stateFor
symbols.comment:
Its state as a reference of `version` and `fingerprint` sees it: on this host `live` also while a restart's open
old attempt binds that version (decision "Reload restarts every affected object", rule 5); `state` over a link.

symbols.name: Target.hydrated
symbols.comment: Whether its state members have values: live once, for a remote object bound once.

symbols.name: Target.variant
symbols.comment: The variant bound last; `undefined` for a local object and before the first binding.

symbols.name: Target.lastFailure
symbols.comment: The error of its last failure (an attempt's, or the dependencies it is parked on) while none went live since.

symbols.name: Target.activationId
symbols.comment: Its instance id while it activates on this host (Q5); `undefined` otherwise and over a link.

symbols.name: Target.blocksFirstPass
symbols.comment:
Whether it holds up this host's start barrier: an object here without its first outcome (decision (a)); a remote
object never does.

symbols.name: Target.hold
symbols.comment: Counts `binding` as a reference; the binding reads `state` itself.

symbols.name: Target.unhold
symbols.comment: `binding` was released.

symbols.name: Target.call
symbols.signature: call(method: string, args: unknown, context: Context, caller: Caller, version: number): Promise<unknown>;
symbols.comment: Calls a method of the live object for `caller`, bound at `version` (an older one is mapped, Q10).

symbols.name: Target.followed
symbols.comment:
What a reference of `version` follows for state member `member` now (decision "References are the only
indirection"): the live instance's member (a replica over a link), or nothing (`loading`, or `failed` with the
cause's error), with the member a reference takes its last value from.

symbols.name: Target.attachable
symbols.comment: The instance its references follow now (they attach to it); `undefined` once it stopped changing.

symbols.name: Target.instance
symbols.comment: Its live instance (a reference's keys pin there; a new one, they pin again); `undefined` when not live.

symbols.name: Target.keyedMember
symbols.comment: The keyed member `member` of the live object: its ultimate slot (slice 6a §12; only local objects have any).

symbols.name: Target.keyedMapping
symbols.signature: keyedMapping(member: string, version: number): ((current: JsonValue) => JsonValue) | undefined;
symbols.comment:
How a consumer of `version` reads keyed member `member`'s documents: mapped back to its version when older
(slice 7b §7), `undefined` when as they are; `contract_mismatch` when the provider refuses it.

symbols.name: Target.pinKey
symbols.signature: pinKey(member: string, key: string, version: number, context: Context): Promise<PinnedKey>;
symbols.comment:
Pins `key` of keyed member `member` on the live instance, loaded, as a consumer of `version` reads it (mapped when
older); only a live local object has keyed members.

symbols.name: Target.retry
symbols.comment:
`ref.retry()`, as one step of `walk`: an attempt now if failed; an object parked on failed dependencies passes it
on; ignored otherwise.

symbols.name: Target.pathTo
symbols.signature: pathTo(target: ChordObject, visited: Set<Target>): ChordObject[] | undefined;
symbols.comment:
The chain of activation waits from this object to `target`, both included (Q5); `undefined` when there is none.
`visited` keeps a search over shared dependencies linear in the waits.

symbols.name: Attachable
symbols.signature: export type Attachable = { readonly variant: string | undefined };
symbols.comment: An instance a reference attaches to (`Target.attachable`): it keeps last values in that instance's variant.

symbols.name: Followed
symbols.comment:
What a reference follows of its target for one state member (`Target.followed`): the member of the instance it
follows (`instance`, still changing), a member its live variant lacks (`invalid/member`), or nothing: its target loads
(no call) or failed (one `failed` call with the cause's error); `last` is the member of `instance`, which stopped
changing, that a reference attached to it takes a last value from (never one it never attached to).

symbols.name: RetryWalk
symbols.signature: export type RetryWalk = { readonly visited: Set<ChordObject>; readonly hops: number };
symbols.comment:
One retry's walk through parked objects on this host (dependency model §3.7, audit A5): the objects it reached (one
reached again, through a diamond, ignores it) and the hop budget a `retry` message to another host carries (none is
sent at 0, so a waiting ring of hosts stops).
symbols.output: { readonly visited: Set<ChordObject>; readonly hops: number }

symbols.name: retryWalk
symbols.comment: A walk starting here: `ref.retry()`'s, with the first host's budget, or a `retry` message's, with one hop less.

symbols.name: CheckedParams
symbols.signature: export type CheckedParams = { readonly params: ParamsOf<Contract>; readonly key: string };
symbols.comment: A reference's params as L1 checked them, with their identity key.
symbols.output: { readonly params: ParamsOf<Contract>; readonly key: string }

symbols.name: BindingState
symbols.comment:
Where a binding stands. `unbound`: waiting for its object's activation to bind it (a `self.get`); `waiting`: in the
host's unbound index, `place` checking it again when woken: before the publication (no `failure`: `loading`), or after
a check that found no fitting provider (`failed { waiting }`, `not_served` or `version`); `refused`: a broken refusal
(a `hostAddress` or `authorize` that threw or refused) until `ref.retry()` places it again; a released binding keeps
nothing but its name and its end (`ref.state`'s `ended`). `dependent` is the object whose attempt declared the
reference with `self.get`, `undefined` for `host.get`, `host.hold` and `ctx.get`.

symbols.name: leave
symbols.comment: Takes it out of the index (it ended).

symbols.name: Decision
symbols.comment: What a wait for a state decides at each change.

symbols.name: Waiter
symbols.signature: type Waiter = { readonly check: () => void; readonly end: (error: ChordError) => void };
symbols.comment: A wait for a state: checked at every change, rejected with the reference's end.
symbols.output: { readonly check: () => void; readonly end: (error: ChordError) => void }

symbols.name: Binding
symbols.signature: export class Binding implements Holder, UnboundRequest {
symbols.comment:
A reference's binding to its object: counted by the object as one of its references while bound, and told of each
change of its state. Calls run while live, park while loading (sent in order once live) and reject while failed.
Released, or ended with its object, it ends the watches taken through it and rejects the calls made through it.

symbols.name: Binding.caller
symbols.comment: Who calls through this reference: the principal it was got as, and this host's incarnation.

symbols.name: Binding.#name
symbols.comment: The contract's name, for errors.

symbols.name: Binding.#contract
symbols.comment: The consumer's contract (its version is the binding's) until the reference is released (it keeps none then).

symbols.name: Binding.#parkTimeout
symbols.comment: How long a call made while loading waits: the reference's `readyTimeout`.

symbols.name: Binding.#calls
symbols.comment:
Aborted when the reference ends: its calls' callers are rejected and their handlers' contexts aborted. Made by the
first call and dropped at the end, so a released reference keeps no error (whose stack keeps its frames).

symbols.name: Binding.#parked
symbols.comment: Calls made while loading; made by the first.

symbols.name: Binding.#waiters
symbols.comment: Waits for a state (getters, member watches before the first binding); each checks the state at every change.

symbols.name: Binding.#refState
symbols.comment: `ref.state`, made on first access.

symbols.name: Binding.#ats
symbols.comment: The keys its object's factory pinned with `ref.member.at(key)`: pinned once bound, released with it.

symbols.name: Binding.#sources
symbols.comment: Its state members as consumers follow them (`ReferenceSource`), by name; each made by its first use.

symbols.name: Binding.#heldKeys
symbols.comment: The keys of its object's keyed members it holds (key watches, `at(key)` pins); made by the first.

symbols.name: Binding.#attached
symbols.comment: The instance it attached to last: it takes last values only from that one (never one it never followed).

symbols.name: Binding.#listed
symbols.comment: Whether presence lists show it: every reference but a restart's readiness bindings (`unlist`).

symbols.name: Binding.constructor
symbols.signature:
constructor(
		contract: Contract,
		batch: Batch,
		dependent: ChordObject | undefined,
		caller: Caller,
		parkTimeout: number,
	)

symbols.name: Binding.contract
symbols.comment: The consumer's contract: its version is the binding's. Only an unreleased binding is asked.

symbols.name: Binding.dependent
symbols.comment: The object whose attempt declared this reference, until it is released.

symbols.name: Binding.principal
symbols.comment: Whom it acts for (the unbound index's revocation).

symbols.name: Binding.refState
symbols.comment: The reference's state.

symbols.name: Binding.target
symbols.comment: The object it is bound to; `undefined` while it is not bound.

symbols.name: Binding.label
symbols.comment: The object in errors: its label once bound, else the contract's name.

symbols.name: Binding.lastFailure
symbols.comment: The error of the object's last failure while none went live since, or of the check that left it unbound.

symbols.name: Binding.bind
symbols.comment:
Binds to `target`, which counts this binding as a reference; its members and keys follow what `target` shows now
(one frame from their last values), and the reference takes its state.

symbols.name: Binding.following
symbols.comment: Whether its members or keys were used: `retarget` moves them (in a batch).

symbols.name: Binding.retarget
symbols.comment:
Inside a batch when `following`: its members and keys follow what its object shows now (`Target.followed`): the live instance's
members (moved there, one frame each), or their last values (one `failed` call for a failure). The first time it
points at nothing, every member of its version gets its last value, read or not.

symbols.name: Binding.removed
symbols.comment:
Its object left it (slice 7b §6): its type was removed, or its provider no longer binds its version. The request
waits unbound with `removal.cause` in the host's index, its members and keys keeping their last values (taken from
the instance it leaves; one `failed` call), and binds again, by name, when a publication serves it: its members
move to the next object's instance and its keys pin there again (one frame each); parked calls flush or reject;
presence lists it again.

symbols.name: Binding.#keepAll
symbols.comment:
Every state member of its version, in the variant of the instance it attached to (its object may be live no more),
gets a source, read or not, so each keeps a last value while it points at nothing (no-op for one already made).

symbols.name: Binding.wait
symbols.signature: wait(cause: FailureCause | undefined, place: () => void, leave: () => void): void
symbols.comment:
Leaves the reference unbound in the host's unbound index (`leave` takes it out): `loading` before the publication
(no `cause`), else `failed` with `cause` (`waiting`); `place` checks it again when the index wakes it.

symbols.name: Binding.wake
symbols.comment: Woken by the unbound index (out of it already): checked again where it goes.

symbols.name: Binding.refuse
symbols.comment:
A reference that cannot be bound (where it goes refused it): failed broken with `cause` until `ref.retry()` runs
`bind` again (a route's `authorize` may admit it later).

symbols.name: Binding.moved
symbols.comment:
The state may have changed: `ref.state`'s watches are told; live sends the parked calls in order, failed
rejects them with the cause; waits for a state decide; the object whose attempt declared it re-evaluates.

symbols.name: Binding.listed
symbols.comment: Whether presence lists show it (§19).

symbols.name: Binding.unlist
symbols.comment: Keeps it out of presence lists, before it binds: a restart's readiness binding is no consumer of its own.

symbols.name: Binding.#hydratedNow
symbols.comment: Whether its members have values now: bound to an object that shows it live and has them.

symbols.name: Binding.until
symbols.signature: until(done: (state: RefState) => boolean, context: Context): Promise<void>
symbols.comment: Resolves once `done(state)` holds, checked now and at every change; rejects at its end or `context`'s abort.

symbols.name: Binding.live
symbols.comment: Resolves when the reference is live; rejects with a broken failure's error, or its end. Getters wait for it.

symbols.name: Binding.member
symbols.comment:
The state member behind `member`, as consumers follow it (`ReferenceSource`): the instance's member while its
object is live, its last value while it points at nothing; reads throw `released`, the failure's error, or
`not_ready` when it never had a value.

symbols.name: Binding.#memberSource
symbols.comment: The source of state member `member`, made by its first use, following what its target shows now.

symbols.name: Binding.none
symbols.comment: What a read of a member that never had a value throws: `released`, the failure's error, or `not_ready`.

symbols.name: Binding.keyedSlot
symbols.comment: The keyed member `member`'s slot (slice 6a §12), as `member` resolves a state member.

symbols.name: Binding.keyedMapping
symbols.comment: How this reference reads keyed member `member`'s documents (`Target.keyedMapping`), as `keyedSlot` resolves.

symbols.name: Binding.pinKey
symbols.signature: pinKey(member: string, key: string, context: Context): Promise<PinnedKey>
symbols.comment:
Holds `key` of keyed member `member` (a key watch, a factory's `at(key)`, an object re-exposing this member): its
source, pinned on the live instance and following its object's instances (`ReferenceKeys`); `release` once.

symbols.name: Binding.#target
symbols.comment: The bound object unless it failed: throws `released`, the failure's error, `not_ready` before the binding.

symbols.name: Binding.watch
symbols.signature: async watch(member: string, context: Context): Promise<Watch<JsonValue>>
symbols.comment:
A watch of `member` that ends when this reference is released, through its member (`ReferenceSource`): opened at
once once it has a value (its last one while its object is not live, frames again when it is); before its first
value it waits for its object's (`firstValues`: through failures, until the reference ends or `context` aborts).

symbols.name: Binding.firstValues
Binding.hydrated
symbols.comment: Resolves once the object's members have values; rejects when the reference fails or is released first.

symbols.name: Binding.follow
symbols.comment:
Ends `watch` when this reference is released; returns it. A watch opened while the reference was released (an
async keyed watch racing `release`) is ended at once, its pin with it, and the caller gets `released`.

symbols.name: Binding.at
symbols.comment:
`ref.member.at(key)`: only while its object's factory runs (the reference not yet bound); pinned once bound
(`pinKeys`), released with the reference.

symbols.name: Binding.pinsKeys
symbols.comment: Whether its object's factory pinned keys on it (`at(key)`).

symbols.name: Binding.pinKeys
symbols.comment:
Pins the keys of `at(key)` on the live object's keyed members and loads those not in memory, before the
dependent goes live (slice 6a §12); `undefined` when there are none. A failed load rejects.

symbols.name: Binding.retry
Binding.release
symbols.comment: Releases the reference (idempotent); the object may end when it was its last.

symbols.name: Binding.end
symbols.comment:
Ends the reference without releasing it from its object (it ended): watches end, calls (running and parked)
reject with `error`, `ref.state` is `ended` with it; the object whose attempt declared it checks again.

symbols.name: Binding.#call
symbols.signature: #call(method: string, args: unknown, context: Context): Promise<unknown>

symbols.name: Binding.#send
symbols.signature: #send(method: string, args: unknown, context: Context): Promise<unknown>
symbols.comment: Calls the live object; the call is aborted when the reference ends.

symbols.name: Binding.#until
symbols.comment:
Settles once `decide` does for the reference's state, checked now and at every change; rejects when the reference
ends (with its error, `released` when it is released already) or `context` aborts.

symbols.name: Binding.#released
symbols.comment: The error of this reference's release by its holder (`released`, no reason).

symbols.name: ReferenceMember
symbols.comment: A state member of a reference: the provider's member, followed through this reference.

symbols.name: ReferenceMember.source
symbols.comment: The provider's member: a source or a constant.

symbols.name: ReferenceKeyed
symbols.comment: A keyed member of a reference (slice 6a §12): reads by key behave as calls (they wait while loading).

symbols.name: ReferenceKeyed.slot
symbols.comment: The provider's slot: the ultimate provider's, through re-exposures (rule 22).

symbols.name: ReferenceKeyed.keyed
symbols.comment: This member as another object re-exposing it has it: its keys held through this reference.

symbols.name: ReferenceKeyed.get
symbols.signature: async get(key: string, context: Context): Promise<JsonValue | undefined>

symbols.name: ReferenceKeyed.watch
symbols.signature: async watch(key: string, context: Context): Promise<Watch<JsonValue> | undefined>
symbols.comment:
A watch of the document at `key` across the object's attempts (it holds the key through the object), `undefined`
when absent; it ends with this reference.

symbols.name: ownAccess
symbols.signature: function ownAccess(slot: KeyedSlot): { readonly token: SealToken; readonly version: number }
symbols.comment: A consumer reads its provider's keyed documents as the provider's own code may: current version, own token.
symbols.output: { readonly token: SealToken; readonly version: number }

symbols.name: AtState
symbols.comment: Where a `ref.member.at(key)` stands: not held yet, held on the object's keyed member, or released for good.

symbols.name: KeyedMemberAt
symbols.comment:
`ref.member.at(key)`: the key's source across the object's attempts once the reference is bound and the key held
(`pin`), until the reference ends (`release`, exactly once): then it drops the source (a retained reference keeps no
provider).

symbols.name: KeyedMemberAt.constructor
symbols.signature: constructor(binding: Binding, member: string, key: string)

symbols.name: KeyedMemberAt.source
symbols.comment: The key's source; `not_ready` before it is held, `released` after.

symbols.name: KeyedMemberAt.pin
symbols.signature: async pin(binding: Binding, context: Context): Promise<void>
symbols.comment:
Holds the key through `binding` (once), loaded, mapped to an older binding's version (slice 7b §7); nothing once
released (a hold that lands then is released).

symbols.name: KeyedMemberAt.release
symbols.comment: Releases the pin and drops the source (once).

symbols.name: resolveKeyed
symbols.signature: export function resolveKeyed(value: unknown): KeyedBinding | undefined
symbols.comment:
What a keyed member's value is (slice 6a §12): a keyed document handle's slot, or a reference's keyed member
(re-exposed); `undefined` for anything else.

symbols.name: resolveWatchable
symbols.signature: export function resolveWatchable(value: unknown): DeriveSource | undefined
symbols.comment:
The watchable Chord follows behind a state member or a derive source (Q14): a source or a constant itself, a
singleton handle's slot, a reference member's provider member, a keyed member's pinned key (a key source itself for
`handle.at(key)`); `undefined` for anything else, a native watchable included.

symbols.name: place
symbols.signature: function place(source: ReferenceSource, followed: Followed, attached: unknown): void
symbols.comment:
Points `source` at what its reference follows now (`Followed`), inside a batch; a new one takes its last value from
the instance that stopped, only when its reference was attached to that one (`attached`).

packages/chord/src/host/reference.ts.comment:
References (§7): what `get` and `hold` return, a plain object built from the contract's members, and its binding to

the object: counted as a reference, it follows the object's state, parks calls while loading, keeps the

per-reference watches and is released once. A binding whose object a reload removed, or whose version it no longer

binds, waits unbound and binds again (slice 7b §6); one of an older version reads adapted members (Q10).

symbols.name: OldWait
symbols.comment: One wait of old work: on what, for which version, under which attempts (its call chain's), and how it is cut.

symbols.name: ReloadCycles
symbols.comment: A host's waits of old work on objects that are not live, while they last.

symbols.name: ReloadCycles.wait
symbols.signature:
wait<T>(
		waiting: Promise<T>,
		target: ChordObject,
		contract: Contract,
		chain: ReadonlySet<OldWorkSource>,
	): Promise<T>
symbols.comment:
`waiting` (a getter's or a gate's wait on `target`, for `contract`'s version) as old work under `chain` makes it:
rejected at once with `unavailable/reload_cycle` if it closes a cycle through that work's own drain, now or once a
later park closes it.

symbols.name: ReloadCycles.recheck
symbols.comment: An attempt parked, or an opener began waiting at a gate: every wait is checked again.

symbols.name: cycleFrom
symbols.signature: function cycleFrom(start: ChordObject, contract: Contract, chain: ReadonlySet<OldWorkSource>): string[] | undefined
symbols.comment:
The labels of a chain of waits from `start` to an object whose open old attempt is in `chain`; `undefined` when
there is none. The start itself counts only through its edges: if its open old attempt serves `contract`'s version,
the old work is routed there (or sees it live) and does not wait at all.

packages/chord/src/host/reload-cycle.ts.comment:
Reload cycles (decision "Reload restarts every affected object; old work finishes on old code", rule 6): a wait of

old work on an object whose activation waits, through its parked dependencies or the gates its opener waits at, on

the old attempt that very work runs on. Nothing would end it but the reload drain bound, so it fails at once with

`unavailable/reload_cycle`, naming the chain. Checked when the wait starts and again whenever an attempt parks or an

opener starts waiting at a gate (a cycle may close after the wait began).

symbols.name: RetrySource
symbols.comment: What `retryOn` takes: sources that live independently of the attempt (a registry value; a constant never wakes).

symbols.name: retrySource
symbols.signature: export function retrySource(source: unknown, label: string): RetrySource
symbols.comment:
Checks a `retryOn` source (declaration policy: TypeScript cannot tell a reference's member or this attempt's
`writable` from a registry value or a constant).

symbols.name: RetryWakes
symbols.comment:
The wake signals of one object: its subscriptions (one set at a time, the last attempt's declaration) and what its
object decides a wake by.

symbols.name: RetryWakes.during
symbols.comment: The attempt a wake arrived during, while it activates: if it fails, it is retried at once.

symbols.name: RetryWakes.leaving
symbols.comment:
Set from its object's contributions leaving until that batch delivered: a composition its own leaving made does
not wake it (an object failing live would retry itself without backoff).

symbols.name: RetryWakes.#subscribed
symbols.signature: #subscribed: { readonly source: RegistryValueSource; readonly observer: NativeObserver<unknown> }[] = [];
symbols.output: { readonly source: RegistryValueSource; readonly observer: NativeObserver<unknown> }[]

symbols.name: RetryWakes.replace
symbols.signature: replace(sources: readonly RetrySource[], wake: () => void): void
symbols.comment: Follows `sources` instead of the previous set; `wake` runs inside the batch of each new value (it only records).

symbols.name: RetryWakes.stop
symbols.comment: Stops following (the object ended, or a new declaration replaces the set).

packages/chord/src/host/retry-on.ts.comment:
Wake signals (slice 8 §3, D2): `self.retryOn(...sources)`. The object follows each declared source while it lives,

replaced by each attempt's declaration; a new value of a source wakes it (the object decides what a wake does: a

retry while failed, remembered while it activates, nothing while live). Failures of a source wake nothing.

symbols.name: RevokedBy
symbols.signature:
export type RevokedBy

= (principal: P) => readonly R[];
symbols.comment: What revokes a principal: the app's typed values, the same function on every host.

symbols.name: RevocationKeys
symbols.comment: A host's revocation keys: each principal's, cached weakly by the principal object.

symbols.name: RevocationKeys.revokes
symbols.signature: revokes(principal: Principal, key: string, context: Context): boolean
symbols.comment:
Whether `key` (a revocation's canonical JSON) is one of `principal`'s revocation keys: the canonical JSON of each
value `revokedBy` returns for it, computed on its first use.

packages/chord/src/host/revocation.ts.comment:
Revocation keys (§4, R10, R11): what `revokedBy` says revokes a principal, as canonical JSON, computed once per

principal object.

symbols.name: RootOptions
symbols.comment: What `host.root` takes besides `fn` and the context.

symbols.name: principal
symbols.comment:
Whom the scope acts as: the host's principal when omitted; a trusted same-host caller's choice (base code), an
explicit `undefined` anonymous (`ctx.principal` undefined).

Root scopes (slice 8 §4, D3, design §8): `host.root(fn, context, options?)`, a call context for code outside objects

(a Durable tool, a CLI), sealed when `fn` settles, when `context` aborts and when the host closes: its signal aborted,

its `ctx.get` refused `released`, every reference it took released.

symbols.name: RouteOptions
symbols.comment: What `host.route` takes for a kind.

symbols.name: authorize
symbols.comment: Whether `principal` may reach `address`; runs for every hold routed over the route, before anything starts.

symbols.name: resolve
symbols.comment:
The link to `address`: `principal` is who the host at the other end is, `trusted` skips the message check on it,
`limits` bound its parts (as `accept`'s). `context` is the route's, aborted when this host closes. Runs at most
once at a time per address.

symbols.name: RouteHandle
symbols.comment: What `host.route` returns: the app's controls of its addresses (D10b, R1).

symbols.name: retry
symbols.comment:
Resolves `address` again now if it has holders and no link: its failure and its suspension end (a Retry button);
an address nobody holds resolves at its next hold.

symbols.name: suspend
symbols.comment:
Resolves nothing for `address` while it has holders: they wait `failed { waiting }` ("suspended") once its link is
gone; the suspension ends with its last holder or `retry`.

symbols.name: Routed
symbols.comment:
One address of a route: its path, whether its `resolve` runs (and its span, when recorded), why it fails its holders,
whether it is suspended.

symbols.name: span
symbols.comment: The running `resolve`'s span: holders attaching meanwhile link to it (decision "Shared work").

symbols.name: failure
symbols.comment: A rejected `resolve`, or a link closed before its handshake: its holders fail with it until the next resolve.

symbols.name: Route
symbols.comment:
A host's route for one kind. An address is kept while it has holders, a link or a running `resolve`: a resolve whose
holds were all released meanwhile finishes, and its link is kept until it closes.

symbols.name: Route.#context
symbols.comment: The route's context, aborted when the host closes: every `resolve` and its links' work run under it.

symbols.name: Route.#links
symbols.signature: readonly #links = new Map<HostLink, { readonly routed: Routed; greeted: boolean }>();
symbols.comment: The addresses' links, which tell their address when they close, and whether each completed its handshake.

symbols.name: Route.path
symbols.signature: path(params: unknown, principal: Principal | undefined, context: Context): Path
symbols.comment:
The path to the address with `params`, for a hold acting as `principal`: the params checked against the kind
(`invalid/host_address`), then `authorize` (`forbidden` when it refuses; a throw is the hold's failure).

symbols.name: Route.retry
symbols.comment: `RouteHandle.retry`: the address's failure and suspension end; it resolves now if held and unlinked.

symbols.name: Route.suspend
symbols.comment: `RouteHandle.suspend`: a held address resolves nothing until `retry` or its last holder; unheld, nothing is kept.

symbols.name: Route.opened
symbols.comment: One of this route's links completed its handshake: a later drop of it resolves its address again.

symbols.name: Route.closed
symbols.comment:
One of this route's links closed: its address resolves again once while held if the link had completed its
handshake, else its holders fail (no loop over a worker that dies at start).

symbols.name: Route.holders
symbols.comment: Every holder of every path of this route, linked or not (revocation ends a revoked principal's).

symbols.name: Route.#changed
symbols.comment:
An address's path changed without a link: a new holder resolves it (a failed address too: a new hold is a new
request), a dropped link resolves it once (or fails it, closed before its handshake), the last holder's release
forgets it (its failure and suspension too) unless its link or `resolve` keeps it.

symbols.name: Route.#resolveIfHeld
symbols.comment: Resolves the address if it has holders, no link, no running `resolve` and no suspension.

symbols.name: Route.#resolve
symbols.comment:
Runs `resolve` once for the address, in a `chord.resolve` root span linked to `trigger` (the span of the hold that
started it, which links back). A rejection, or a link closed already, fails its holders with the error until the
next resolve; a link returned after the host closed is closed at once.

symbols.name: Route.#settle
symbols.comment:
A resolve failed with `error`: its holders fail `failed { waiting }` with it (they stay on its path for its next
link), or the address goes when nobody holds it any more.

symbols.name: resolveEnded
symbols.signature: function resolveEnded(span: OpenSpan<"chord.resolve"> | undefined, error: unknown): void
symbols.comment: A resolve's span ends: `linked`, or `failed` with `error`.

symbols.name: suspended
symbols.comment: The failure holders of a suspended address see.

packages/chord/src/host/route.ts.comment:
Routes (§3): how a host reaches hosts of one kind. `authorize` admits each hold routed over the route; `resolve`

makes the link of one address, at most once at a time. No timer (slice 10 R2): an address resolves for a new hold,

on `RouteHandle.retry`, or once after its link dropped while held; a rejected `resolve` (or a link closed before its

handshake) fails its holders `failed { waiting }` until then, and a suspended address resolves nothing while held.

Each `resolve` is a `chord.resolve` root span linked to the hold that started it (slice 9).

Where routines run: their owner's label (for reports), its host, whom their calls act for, and the context of their
calls, aborted when the owner ends. `admit` adds a running call to the owner's drain.

symbols.name: type
symbols.comment: Its type's name (routine spans).

symbols.name: admit
symbols.comment:
Adds a running call to the drain; `cleanup` (its bookkeeping) runs once, when it settles or when the attempt ends
with it still running.

symbols.comment:
A routine's handler of a JSON source: the value call (the value, the ops since the previous call, whether the
source's document was retired since then) and the call's ctx. Failures are not calls of a handler (design §11): the
routine waits for the next value.

symbols.comment: A routine's handler of a native source: the value call (the value) and the call's ctx.

symbols.signature: export type OnLiveHandler<C extends Ctx = Ctx> = (ctx: C) => void | Promise<void>;
